storyCards.headline: Talking In Your Sleep: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Romantics's "Talking In Your Sleep" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Talking in Your Sleep" is a  song by American rock band the Romantics.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 26 weeks on the chart.

Talking In Your Sleep was released in 1980.

"Talking In Your Sleep" by The Romantics.
